RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the November 28, 2002/Agrahayana 7, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy;
Communications and Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food and
Public Distribution; External Affairs; Labour; Parliamentary Affairs;
Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Road Transport
and Highways; Small Scale Industries; Space; Statistics
and Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions—20
43
Metro Bus Service in Bangalore
*141. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government of Karnataka
have submitted a proposal for approval to
introduce Metro Bus Service in
Bangalore; and
(b) if so, what action Government have
taken thereon?
Meeting of foreign ministers
*142. SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether during the informal
meeting in New York, the Indian, Russian
and Chinese foreign ministers have agreed
to meet officially for holding discussions
between the three countries;
(b) if so, whether any date has been
fixed for the meeting;
(c) if so, the agenda fixed for this
meeting; and
(d) to what extent these three countries
have formulated action plan to give a fillip
to their relationship and have agreed to a
concrete plan of action on various issues?
Export performance in IT sector
†*143. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken
any steps to improve the export
performance in the field of Information
Technology sector;
(b) if so, the details of the
achievements in the field of information
technology, software services and
electronics during the last three years; and
(c) the target fixed to promote export
in these fields and develop computer
hardware manufacturing sector for the
next three years?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

44
WIN2\SESSION\RS-QUES 44
Contradiction in Labour
Commission's report
†*144. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA: Will the Minister of LABOUR
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Report of
the Labour Commission is contradictory;
(b) whether it is also a fact that while
the analysis of Labour Commission are
quite right but the recommendations made
by the Commission are not based on the
same; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Legislation on drunken driving
*145. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
bring forward a new legislation or amend
the existing laws to provide for deterrent
punishment for drunken driving which is
the major cause of accidents; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Delay in pension reforms
*146. DR. C. NARAYANA REDDY:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
intend to delay the Reformed Pension
Plan;
(b) whether Government would
announce the plan before the next Budget;
and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Strengthening of PDS infrastructure
*147. SHRI LAJPAT RAI: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that for the
purpose of strengthening PDS
infrastructure, trucks/vans are also
provided to make available essential
commodities in rural/hilly remote
areas;
(b) whether Government subsidise the
cost of such vehicles;
(c) if so, the amount paid during the
last three years; and
(d) the number of such trucks/vans and
in whose custody Centre/State/Union
Territory Governments these vehicles are
being maintained?
Funds for maintenance of National
Highways
*148. DR. A.K. PATEL: Will the
Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the funds available for repair,
maintenance of National Highways, their
widening and construction of additional
highways for 2002-03;
(b) the demand received from various
States, State-wise, particularly from
Gujarat for 2002-03;
(c) the allocation of funds, State-wise;
and
(d) the brief particulars of the
programme of action for the year
2002-03, State-wise, particularly, for
Gujarat?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Trade agreements between India and

DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL

European Union in the month of October,

(b) whether India and E.U. differ on
Kashmir;
(c) what are the other subjects
discussed and the agreements signed
during the Prime Minister's visit;
(d) whether the E.U. had asked India
to hasten project approvals;

Amount released under PMRY
886.  SHRI C. O. POULOSE: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the amount allocated
and released by Government during the last
two years under the Pradhan Mantri Rozgar
Yojana (PMRY), State-wise;
(b) the mechanism to monitor operation
of the programme;
(c) whether Government have received
any complaints from the States regarding
this scheme; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Development of Agro and Rural
Industries
887. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of agro and rural
industries in the country;
(b) whether there exists a lot of potential
to develop agro and rural industries in the
country; and
(c) if so, the schemes for development
of these industries in view of the existing
potential?
Corruption in PMRY
888. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
number of fraud companies operating in the
Capital which claim that  they can get loans
under the Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana;
(b) whether Government are aware that
there is open corruption under this scheme
and that the officers connected to the same
scheme are bribed by such companies for
loan allotment;
(c) whether Government intend to
unearth this racket and clean the Rozgar
Yojana to help deserving unemployed
candidates; and
(d) if so, by when Government intend to
make their first move in this regard?

197
WIN2\SESSION\3874RS 197
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Sanction of arrears for Centrally-
sponsored Schemes
889. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V. V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Kerala State Agriculture
and Coir Minister has written a letter to
Government requesting sanction of the
arrears of the rebate amounting to Rs. 11.26
crores as one time settlement which the State
Government had spent on account of the
50 per cent Centrally-sponsored scheme of
payment of 20 per cent rebate on sale of coir
yarn and products for the years 1997-98,
1998-99 and 1999-2000; and
(b) if so, Government's response
thereto?
Amendments in Atomic Energy Act,
1962
890.  SHRI C. P. THIRUNAVUK-
KARASU: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
bring amendments in Atomic Energy Act,
1962 to allow the State Governments and
other institutions to participate in
Government-owned Nuclear Power
Projects;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether Government have fixed any
target to produce nuclear power by 2020;
and
(e) if so, the measures proposed to be
taken to achieve the target?
Use of advance fuels
891. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Department
is thinking of using advance fuels like
Nitride and Mettallic for the breader reactors;
(b) if so, the reasons for using advance
fuels when the mixed oxide is a prevalent
fuel world over; and
(c) the power generated through atomic
power stations in the country during the last
five years, year-wise?
Development of ceramic matrix
892. SHRI PARMESHWAR KUMAR
AGARWALLA: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are funding a project under which the work
is being done by a nuclear scientist to
develop a ceramic matrix that would contain
and mobilize test of high level nuclear waste;
(b) if so, what is the present status of the
project; and
(c) by when it is likely to be completed?
Leakage of radioactive substances
†893. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that several incidents of leakage of
the most sensitive radioactive substances of
atomic plants have taken place in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that the
construction and maintenance of atomic
plants is so poor that the incidents like
Chernobil are feared any time;
(d) if so, whether Government have
formulated any scheme to improve
maintenance and safety of the plants; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
